hidden.title: Hidden games
hidden.masked: Hidden games show as “A hidden game”, without art, page or builds. They stay cached and up to date.
hidden.youSee: You see hidden games by name, marked hidden. Anyone who may not hide games sees “A hidden game”.
hidden.browserSees: This browser shows hidden games by name. Other browsers see “A hidden game”.
hidden.none: No game is hidden. A game's page hides it.

panel.title: Privacy
panel.isHidden: Hidden: others see “A hidden game”, without its art, page or builds.
panel.hideHelp: Hide it to mask its name, art, page and builds everywhere. It stays cached and kept up to date.

own.title: Keep it to myself
own.help: Others won't see that you have this game. If nobody else who owns it shares it, they see “A hidden game”. Admins see everything.
own.isKept: Private: others don't see that you have it. Where you are its only owner, they see “A hidden game”.
